noneuclid.portal: Tokens that walk into the Region step out of the linked exit Region, keeping their position relative to the portal.
noneuclid.impossibleSpace: The Region is bigger or smaller on the inside: movement through it costs more or less than its drawn size.

debug.name: Debug Logging
debug.hint: Log extra details about portals and other non-Euclidean effects to the browser console.

exit.label: Exit
exit.hint: The Region a Token comes out of. Give that Region its own Portal behavior pointing back here for a two-way doorway.

preserveOffset.label: Preserve Offset
preserveOffset.hint: Keep the Token's position relative to the portal. Otherwise it comes out at the center of the exit.

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.hint: Degrees the Token turns by when it comes out of the exit.

snap.label: Snap to Grid
snap.hint: Snap the Token to the grid at the exit.

Portal.NoCrossScenePermission: You do not have permission to move Tokens between Scenes.

scale.label: Inside Scale
scale.hint: How many times longer distances are inside the Region. 2 means bigger on the inside; 0.5 means smaller.
